slice.name: cut_3S (L0 smoke slice, interior)
slice.why: interior slice: every inbound lane has a landing (the end slices do not, G3); u_s_3S sid 6 is the compiler smoke slice

cost.note: build once per slice netlist (43 min); every replay / mutant reuses the binary. L0 price 15,475 cycles -> ~4.5 min a run at 57 cyc/s; the whole-die build OOMs > 400 GB (probe_v2), so the slice is the vehicle

replay_L0_s3S.what: the compiled L0 slice-norm smoke CTL beats (8: HLOAD, GAIN, NORM k0-4, XFIN_GO; prog_L0_s3S) replayed at u_s_4S ro_w at their scheduled cycles; checks: the forwarded beat at u_s_2S landing out, every lane at the bundle cycle
replay_L0_s3S.result: 0/8 beats at the scheduled cycle; all 8 present 10 edges early with exact payload + hops 3; land_fault

diag_L0_s3S.verdict: checks PASS (0/32 mismatches) at the measured cycle (schedule - 10, DIAGNOSTIC), land_fault FAIL
diag_L0_s3S.what: payload / hops of the real slice ring stop forward path

runs.lane_debug: runs/lane_debug: 3 lanes alone (211 inst, 65,700 cyc/s): K5 lanes fault + deliver at src+6 (plan 10), K2 lane clean
runs.flight_time_tt: runs/idle_flighttime_tt + lane_debug_flighttime_tt: --land-plan back-annotation of -S1 as a transport delay: Verilator 5.050 drops the delayed pulses (data never reaches the ring) and the rate falls to 5.9 cyc/s; not used for verdicts (and without the hop-0 gate the integer flight time cannot reach the epoch anyway, G1)

composition: the layer = the slowest (critical) slice under the fixed schedule: every slice runs the same calendar shifted by its CTL arrival; L0 critical = an end slice (latest CTL arrival, e.g. u_s_0S 56.5 edges vs u_s_3S 27, and the TP all-reduce edge links) -> blocked on G3; the interior 3S cut is the smoke vehicle
